content: May 28, 2024 Resources for CDC Recipients Key points When a recipient accepts a CDC grant or cooperative agreements, they must comply with the requirements of the notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and notice of award (NoA). This section offers information on grants management activities for recipients. Overview When a recipient accepts a CDC grant or cooperative agreement , they must comply with the requirements outlined in the notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and notice of award (NoA) . The recipient must actively manage their award for adherence to the applicable requirements. This section offers information on grants management activities for recipients including payment , prior approval requests , reporting , closeout , and other general topics .
